description: T-4587: which sheet-scoped definition a bare name in an API-added (Graph names/add) workbook name binds to, when the candidate sheets differ in letter case or start with an underscore. Tabs Z, B, a, _u (Z active, B1 = 1, 2, 3, 4), no workbook definitions; workbook names W_1..W_4 = =Dup_1..=Dup_4 added through the API. Dup_1: B's (B1 = 2) + a's (3): 3 if the order ignores case, 2 if it is ordinal (B < a). Dup_2: a's (3) + _u's (4). Dup_3: B's (2) + _u's (4): 2 if '_' sorts after the letters' upper case, 4 if before. Dup_4: Z's (1) + a's (3): 3 is by name, not tab order.
